sections.h2: India's wine market: US$195.3 million, forecast to grow four-fold by 2032

chart.title: Growth is four-fold on paper, from a market of US$195.3 million
chart.source: IMARC Group, India Wine Market report.

sections.means: IMARC Group puts India's wine market at US$195.3 million in 2023, forecast to reach US$802.9 million by 2032.
sections.todo: Check the 2032 forecast against actual annual sales before treating the 17.01% CAGR as settled.

sections.h2: The 150% tariff wall, and an EU deal that would cut it in phases

chart.title: The initial cut takes wine from 150% to 75%, with lower phased rates after
chart.source: India-EU FTA trade reporting, following the 27 January 2026 political agreement.
rows: Initial cut on entry into force

sections.means: The India-EU political agreement of 27 January 2026 would cut wine tariffs from 150% to 75% on entry into force, then to 20% for premium and 30% for mid-range wine.
sections.todo: Track ratification and the phased schedule, not the headline tariff figure, before judging how the market will change.

sections.h2: Sula Vineyards reports over half of domestic 100%-grape wine

chart.title: Sula's reported share exceeds half of the 100%-grape wine category
chart.source: Sula Vineyards IPO-era regulatory filings and disclosures.

sections.means: Sula reported 52.6% of domestic 100%-grape wine in FY2021, and about 61% of the Elite and Premium segments in FY2022.
sections.todo: Read Sula's share as a category figure, not as its share of every bottle of wine sold in India.
